style.prompt: Design a striking vertical NIGHT MARKET event poster, polished professional graphic design. Atmospheric illustrated night market street at night, glowing red and golden paper lanterns strung overhead, inviting street food stalls, curling steam, small silhouettes of visitors, deep midnight navy background with vivid coral red, warm amber and electric teal accents. Strong visual hierarchy, elegant balanced composition, rich screen-print textures, modern travel-poster aesthetic, sharp graphic shapes with luminous lighting. No invented dates, locations, prices, sponsors or logos. Make the poster feel lively, stylish and welcoming.
